summary: Card opened in todo (idea). WATCH card for two RunPod announcements. Deploy-When-Available went GA 18 Jun 2026 but is CONSOLE-ONLY - verified against the live REST schema (POST /pods has no queue/schedule/subscription field) and our create path is REST plus the GraphQL podFindAndDeployOnDemand fallback, so nothing to hook; autoRetry (MPI-110) is our app-side equivalent and is safer on billing (never runs with the app closed) but loses the race to a real server-side reservation. Re-open when the field appears in a schema, and gate it behind explicit consent - not folded into autoRetry. Second half is the real signal: RunPod publicly steered users off network volumes and ruled out credits, and our remote engine is volume-pinned; the escape hatch already exists (R2 weights plus ephemeral Any-region pods, MPI-78) so the work is to MEASURE ephemeral-first, not build it. Also narrows the Vast.ai no-volumes red flag in MPI-344. Detail in brief.md.
